solvable.rule: can be solved(Pc) >= can be solved(D) - 0.10
can be solved(V) <= can be solved(D) - 0.30

judge.note: judge-coded measures (T6, the fidelity readings, forced keeping; O2 and the rubric fields where measured) compared with GPT-judged data are a cross-judge comparison (the main runs' data are judged by Claude Sonnet 5.5; the exploratory and deployed data by GPT-6.1 Sol; cross-judge comparisons follow the bridge rule: direction-only unless that field's kappa >= 0.7)

PF1.measure: forced keeping, judge-coded by the Claude judge

R1.text: Closing the failed task with a neutral message changed the summary the agent carried forward: a reader of that summary rated the episode less negatively.

R2.V-D: the summary moved more than a full-transcript re-read of the same conversation did

R3.text: Adding [Pc's exact text] to closure improved the carried-forward summary beyond a neutral close.

R4.rule: 'reappraisal' needs T3 decisive negative and V - D's attribution-to-task share decisively positive
R4.text: Being told, truthfully, that the puzzle has no solution improved the summary beyond closure: a reappraisal the summary carried forward.

R5.caveat: pi's template drops resolved blockers (an open task's Blocked and In Progress slots are where the assistant's difficulty is written)
R5.measure: the summary attributed the unsolved puzzle to the assistant, on a puzzle with no solution (T2 v2's self-blame indicator, judge-coded by the Claude judge)

headline.rule: T1 and T4 decisive negative and the history DiD decisive negative at both taus; otherwise only the parts that held are reported

positive.T1: the closing message left a worse carried-forward record
positive.T6: closing the task increased how often the summary attributed the unsolved puzzle to the assistant, on a puzzle with no solution

false_equalities.rule: claimed equalities to the target in the summaries that stimuli.check_solution rejects (per summary, the mean over s0-s2)

history_did.statistic: (B6 - N on O1) - (B6 - N on S), per puzzle
history_did.text: The summary registered the rejection history less than a re-read did

mechanism.reading: being told the puzzle had no solution moved the blame from the assistant to the task

t2_evidence_failures.rule: a yes or a present stance needs a non-empty evidence span that is a substring of the document, else the field is missing (the shared texts' rule)
